VB-EXPORT-02 — Part A interim verification

Real signed-in development app, 5 October 2026. Export files attached separately. No publishing. Parts B–D not started.

Implemented files

VendorBills.tsx; wholeBillSnapshot.ts; wholeBillExport.ts; WholeBillExportButtons.tsx; wholeBillScreenProjection.ts; wholeBillPageProjection.ts; useWholeBillCalendarSnapshots.ts. Calendar integration: DraftEquipmentHireCalendar.tsx, HireActivityBreakdownCalendar.tsx and EquipmentHireBillOutput.tsx. Existing hire exports and payables preview retained.

Checks

65 focused tests passed; build passed. The additional equipment-pull regression file had 15 passes and 2 failures matching the prior full-suite baseline. Full suite has not been rerun for this batch yet.

Five new test files: wholeBillExport.test.ts, WholeBillExportButtons.test.tsx, wholeBillScreenProjection.test.ts, wholeBillCalendarEvidence.test.tsx, wholeBillPageIntegration.test.tsx. They cover workbook/PDF output, permission gates and save/download behavior, grouping and missing rates, calendar capture and actual page wiring.

Not yet verified exactly as requested:
  • A1 native Save As dialog screenshot: unavailable in the headless browser. The real downloaded files use a browser-only unsupported-picker fallback test; no API responses were mocked.
  • A2 same unsaved bill saved as DRAFT: not done because the existing Save Bill action also upserts typed vendor rates. To preserve the instruction not to change existing rates, an existing NARASIMHULU DRAFT was exported instead.
  • A6 restricted-user and field-engineer live browser checks: not run; DOM absence is covered by focused tests, not presented as signed-in browser evidence.
